doubts: The end ref F1 (where Careys Creek Track meets Evansdale Glen Road) is taken as the Evansdale Glen/Waimoi end from the Evansdale Glen Entrance text, where the car park is in the gravel turn-around before the ford; F2 is a different unnamed track on the Waikouaiti-Waitati Road nearby and is not used. The page says the track can be walked in the opposite direction from Evansdale Glen; this is recorded as an access point, not a separate way. The side-trip loop (Honeycomb Track and Rongomai Track) has its own times (Honeycomb 60 min one way, 1.8 km; Rongomai 40 min one way, 2.2 km), but the page does not say where it leaves Careys Creek Track, so from is null. The track crosses the creek numerous times, but the text does not say whether those crossings are unbridged, so no ford tag.
